resolved.title: SMS verification codes not arriving for some users
resolved.reported_issue: Around 20% of users never receive the SMS one-time code at login. Retrying sometimes works after several minutes.
resolved.logs: WARN [otp-sender] provider=twilio status=429 Too Many Requests
resolved.cause: OTP texts shared the Twilio sender pool with a marketing campaign; the provider rate-limited the pool and returned HTTP 429, and the OTP sender had no retry.
resolved.workaround: Offer the voice-call or email code option at login.
resolved.resolution: Moved OTP traffic to a dedicated Twilio messaging service, added retry with exponential backoff on 429, and enabled failover to voice after two failed attempts.
preventive_actions: Keep OTP and marketing traffic on separate sender pools
Alert when the provider 429 rate exceeds 2% over 5 minutes

resolved.title: Users logged out every few minutes
resolved.reported_issue: Staff are signed out of the admin portal every 3 to 5 minutes and must log in again.
resolved.cause: Clock drift of about 6 minutes on node auth-03 made freshly issued JWTs look expired to other nodes.
resolved.workaround: Remove auth-03 from the load balancer.
resolved.resolution: Restored NTP sync on auth-03 and returned it to the pool.
preventive_actions: Alert on NTP drift above 30 seconds
Allow 60 seconds of clock leeway in JWT validation

resolved.title: Dashboard widgets blank after deploy
resolved.reported_issue: After the release, dashboard widgets render as empty grey panels until users hard refresh.
resolved.cause: The CDN kept serving a cached index.html that referenced JavaScript chunks removed by the new deploy, causing ChunkLoadError in the browser.
resolved.resolution: Purged the CDN cache and set Cache-Control: no-cache on index.html so it is always revalidated.
preventive_actions: Add a CDN purge step to the deploy pipeline
Keep the previous release's chunks available for 24 hours

resolved.title: Charts show no data for EU tenants
resolved.reported_issue: EU tenants see empty charts with a 'no data' message; US tenants are fine.
resolved.cause: The EU read replica fell more than 5 minutes behind and metrics queries timed out.
resolved.workaround: Point EU dashboard queries at the primary database.
resolved.resolution: Rebuilt the lagging replica and added automatic fallback to the primary when lag exceeds 60 seconds.
preventive_actions: Alert on replica lag above 60 seconds

resolved.title: Customers charged twice after checkout retry
resolved.reported_issue: Several customers were charged twice for one checkout after the page showed an error and they clicked Pay again.
resolved.logs: WARN [gateway] upstream 504 timeout; ERROR [charge] duplicate charge detected idempotency_key=null
resolved.cause: On a gateway 504 the checkout client retried the charge without forwarding the Idempotency-Key header, so the gateway created a second charge.
resolved.workaround: Refund duplicates manually from the gateway console.
resolved.resolution: Forwarded the Idempotency-Key on every retry from the checkout client and refunded the 37 duplicate charges.
preventive_actions: Contract test that every charge request carries an Idempotency-Key

resolved.title: Card payments failing with 502
resolved.reported_issue: All card payments fail with a generic error since 02:00 UTC.
resolved.cause: The payment gateway rotated its TLS certificate to a new CA that was missing from our CA bundle.
resolved.workaround: None; payments were down until the fix.
resolved.resolution: Updated the CA bundle in the payments-api image and redeployed.
preventive_actions: Use the OS trust store instead of a pinned bundle

resolved.title: m4a uploads fail during conversion
resolved.reported_issue: Voice notes recorded on iPhone (.m4a) fail with 'unsupported format'; WAV files work.
resolved.logs: ERROR [transcode] ffmpeg: Decoder (codec aac) not found
resolved.cause: The new transcoder image used an ffmpeg build without the AAC decoder.
resolved.resolution: Rebuilt the transcoder image with AAC support.
preventive_actions: Codec smoke test for m4a, mp3 and wav in CI

resolved.title: Large uploads fail at 99 percent
resolved.reported_issue: Uploads above 2 GB reach 99% and then fail with 'access denied'.
resolved.cause: Presigned multipart URLs expired after 15 minutes, before large uploads finished.
resolved.resolution: Extended presigned URL expiry to 60 minutes and refreshed URLs per part.
preventive_actions: Test uploads of 5 GB on slow links before release

resolved.title: Email notifications delayed by hours
resolved.reported_issue: Order confirmation emails arrive 3 to 4 hours late.
resolved.logs: ERROR [consumer] TemplateRenderError: missing variable 'first_name'; consumer restarting
resolved.cause: A malformed template made the queue consumer crash and restart in a loop, so the backlog grew to 180k messages.
resolved.resolution: Sent malformed messages to a dead-letter queue, fixed the template, and scaled consumers to drain the backlog.
preventive_actions: Alert when queue age exceeds 10 minutes

resolved.title: Password reset emails landing in spam
resolved.reported_issue: Users report password reset emails in their spam folder since Monday.
resolved.cause: The DKIM key was rotated without publishing the new DNS record, so messages failed DKIM.
resolved.resolution: Published the new DKIM DNS record and verified alignment.
preventive_actions: Checklist for DKIM rotation including DNS verification

open.title: Login verification texts delayed or missing for EU customers
open.reported_issue: Since this morning many EU users say the login code text never arrives or arrives 10+ minutes late. US users seem unaffected. Support has 40 tickets in two hours.
open.logs: Customer screenshot: 'We couldn't send your code. Try again.'

open.title: Dashboard shows blank panels after this morning's release
open.reported_issue: After the 08:00 release every widget on the operations dashboard is an empty grey box. One user said it fixed itself in an incognito window.

open.title: Some customers double charged on subscription renewal
open.reported_issue: Five members were charged twice for their monthly renewal last night. Checkout purchases look normal.
